name: The Supermarket
archetype: A national grocery chain — stores, distribution centres, buying, own-brand

ca.what: Food safety, labelling and recalls — inspection standards and enforcement across the food supply.
Food composition, additives and product safety rules under the Food and Drugs Act.
Pricing claims, drip pricing and advertising — misleading representations and deceptive marketing.
Accuracy of scales and measured quantities — deli counters, produce scales and checkout.

uk.what: Hygiene and safety standards — enforced with local authority environmental health teams; store hygiene ratings.
Enforces the Groceries Supply Code of Practice — fair dealing with suppliers by the largest grocers.
Weights and measures, pricing accuracy, age-restricted sales and consumer law at store level.
Workplace safety in stores, depots and transport yards — manual handling, machinery, vehicle movements.

roles.title: Board of Directors
roles.about: Elected by shareholders to govern the grocer. Sets strategy and risk appetite, approves capital plans for stores and supply chain, appoints and holds the CEO to account. Works through its Audit, Compensation and Corporate Responsibility committees.
